description: Maharashtra is set to use AI for policing and crime prevention. But with no concrete AI regulations in India, is there a risk of bias?
body_lead: With additional reporting by Sakshi Sadashiv K Maharashtra’s Finance Minister Ajit Pawar has announced that the state will set up an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered command control centre to keep crimes in check in Mumbai. Pawar mentioned in his budget speech yesterday that this centre will be set up at the Mumbai Police Commissioner’s office and will be used for crime prevention, emergency responses, and public safety. Notably, Pawar did not elaborate on how the centre will use AI for policing or the specific crimes this centre would tackle.
